question: Does Source B specificity disappear in the initial vocabulary projection, during diffusion denoising, or because the final decoder does not directly receive the source prompt?

conditions.purpose: Reproduce the failed Experiment 002 B control while locating when specificity disappears.
Test whether stronger source wording preserves the named implementation details.
Positive diagnostic control: test whether the trained model can retain Source B when the decoder sees the prompt directly.

interpretation.missing_at_step_0: Information is absent after continuous-state-to-token projection, before iterative denoising.
interpretation.present_at_step_0_then_missing: Denoising removes the Source B details.
interpretation.restored_by_explicit_source_prompt: Prompt specificity is a major control variable.
interpretation.restored_only_when_decoder_sees_prompt: The source-conditioned canvas state does not reliably carry B through projection, although direct prompt conditioning can generate it.
interpretation.missing_even_when_decoder_sees_prompt: The prompt/model combination itself is an inadequate positive control.

important_limitations: This diagnoses one Source B prompt and does not test A+B interpolation.
The explicit prompt intentionally makes the required terms easy to identify; it is a positive control, not a novelty test.
The original entropy-weighted mean of two identical B states is mathematically the same B state.
